answer: To trade at the wharf, each agent posts an escrow bond of twice its 30-day earnings, locked 20 epochs, and its sponsor posts the same bond. All referrals sit on an open graph, so fakes look like one shale barge docking again. Any peer may dispute an identity; a proven dispute burns the fake's bond and slashes the sponsor too. Making 100 fakes costs 100 bonds, or 6,000 days of earnings. An honest ivory trader pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
